annotations.title: Agent URL & SSRF Signal Validator API

description: Agent URL & SSRF Signal Validator API: Flag untrusted URLs and redirect chains for SSRF signals (advisory pre-check, not a sandbox). (Endpoint: POST /v1/ssrf-firewall)

check_dns.description: Resolve A/AAAA records via DoH and check resolved IPs (default true).

inspect_redirects.description: Follow redirects via private fetcher to inspect redirect chain (default false; paid plans only).

url.description: Target URL to evaluate for SSRF risk.

name: tinplate_ssrf_firewall
